items.claim: Ryan Cous is a gritty, well-rounded fighter who will grind people out if not put away.
items.quote: he's one of these guys that is well-rounded. He's bluecollar. He's gritty.

items.claim: Mario Barbosza will knock out Ryan Cous in the first round.
items.quote: I think he's getting knocked out in the first round.

items.claim: Stan Dorsonville is an inch taller and has a 6-inch reach advantage over Gage Young.
items.quote: Dorsonville an inch taller at 510. He's got a 6 in reach advantage at 76 in of reach.

items.claim: Stan Dorsonville is taking this UFC opportunity on short notice with less than 10 pro fights.
items.quote: Dorsonville who has to take a UFC opportunity on short notice, who has had less than 10 pro fights

items.claim: Gage Young will be too physical and have answers for the takedowns against Stan Dorsonville.
items.quote: I think that Gage Young is going to be a little bit physical for him. I think Gage Young is going to have an answer for the takedowns.

items.claim: Wes Schultz submitted Jackson McVey when they fought on the amateur scene.
items.quote: these guys actually fought back on the amateur scene and Schultz submitted McVey.

items.claim: Jackson McVey is the more dangerous and aesthetically better fighter compared to Wes Schultz.
items.quote: McVey to me just seems like the more dangerous guy. He seems like he's just aesthetically better to watch.

items.claim: Wes Schultz's takedowns, kicks, and punches lack power or impact.
items.quote: his takedowns don't have much on them. His kicks don't have much on them, his punches don't have much on them.
